rules.title: schoolz: API is not reporting

annotations.summary: No schoolz-api machine has reported in 10 minutes
annotations.description: Every API machine exports a memory sample every 30s and one machine is always kept running, so silence means none is up (or telemetry export broke). The site shows empty pages while this lasts.

rules.title: schoolz: scheduler has stopped reconciling

annotations.summary: The scheduler hasn't ticked in 10 minutes - every scan is stopped
annotations.description: It reconciles every 30s, so this should never be below 1. Nothing else will tell you: pages keep serving yesterday's data and no run fails, because no run starts.

rules.title: schoolz: site unreachable from outside

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.instance }} is failing from every probe location
annotations.description: The only alert that sees what a visitor sees: DNS, TLS, Fly's proxy and the app together. Every location must fail for two checks in a row, so one probe's bad network can't page. If the app's own alerts are quiet, the problem is in front of it.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: API availability error budget burning fast

annotations.summary: API availability: error budget burning fast (objective 99.5% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of API requests from real visitors answered without a 5xx. At this rate the whole 28-day error budget is gone in about two days. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1h, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 6h.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: API availability error budget burning steadily

annotations.summary: API availability: error budget burning steadily (objective 99.5% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of API requests from real visitors answered without a 5xx. Nothing is on fire, but this pace spends the 28-day error budget before the window ends. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1d, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 3d.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: API latency error budget burning fast

annotations.summary: API latency: error budget burning fast (objective 95.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of interactive GETs answered within 1 second. At this rate the whole 28-day error budget is gone in about two days. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1h, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 6h.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: API latency error budget burning steadily

annotations.summary: API latency: error budget burning steadily (objective 95.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of interactive GETs answered within 1 second. Nothing is on fire, but this pace spends the 28-day error budget before the window ends. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1d, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 3d.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: Prerender for crawlers error budget burning fast

annotations.summary: Prerender for crawlers: error budget burning fast (objective 99.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of /prerender requests (search engines and link previews) that returned a page. At this rate the whole 28-day error budget is gone in about two days. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1h, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 6h.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: Prerender for crawlers error budget burning steadily

annotations.summary: Prerender for crawlers: error budget burning steadily (objective 99.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of /prerender requests (search engines and link previews) that returned a page. Nothing is on fire, but this pace spends the 28-day error budget before the window ends. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1d, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 3d.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: Scan runs error budget burning fast

annotations.summary: Scan runs: error budget burning fast (objective 99.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of scan runs that finished without an error (warnings count as finished). At this rate the whole 28-day error budget is gone in about two days. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1h, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 6h.

rules.title: schoolz SLO: Scan runs error budget burning steadily

annotations.summary: Scan runs: error budget burning steadily (objective 99.0% over 28d)
annotations.description: Share of scan runs that finished without an error (warnings count as finished). Nothing is on fire, but this pace spends the 28-day error budget before the window ends. Burn rate {{ printf "%.1f" $values.A.Value }}x over 1d, {{ printf "%.1f" $values.C.Value }}x over 3d.

rules.title: schoolz: no scan has run in 13 hours

annotations.summary: No scan of any kind has run in 13 hours
annotations.description: The cheapest feeds run every 12h, so a full 13h with zero runs means the scheduler is up but not firing jobs (every job disabled, or the reconcile loop is not loading them).

rules.title: schoolz: a scan has been running for over an hour

annotations.summary: A {{ $labels.job_kind }} run has been in flight for over an hour
annotations.description: The reaper clears runs with no progress after 45 minutes, so one still in flight is either checkpointing slowly or holding a concurrency slot. Look for real evidence before force-erroring it.

rules.title: schoolz: process memory above 85% of its machine

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.service_name }} is at {{ humanizePercentage $values.B.Value }} of its machine's memory
annotations.description: The next step is an OOM kill, which for the scheduler abandons whatever scan was running. Limits are the Fly machine sizes in backend/fly.toml.

model.expr: max by (service_name) (process_memory_usage_bytes{service_namespace="schoolz", service_name="schoolz-api"}) / 536870912 or max by (service_name) (process_memory_usage_bytes{service_namespace="schoolz", service_name="schoolz-scheduler"}) / 1073741824

rules.title: schoolz: database pool fully checked out

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.service_name }} has held {{ $values.B.Value }} of its 6 database connections for 10 minutes
annotations.description: Pool is 4 + 2 overflow per process; at 6 every further request waits and then fails with db_pool_timeout. Usually one slow query or a leaked session.

rules.title: schoolz: an LLM reply was truncated (max_tokens)

annotations.summary: A {{ $labels.purpose }} reply hit the output cap and was cut off
annotations.description: A truncated extraction has silently produced zero items from a full newsletter before - the run does not necessarily look failed.

rules.title: schoolz: scraper is not reporting

annotations.summary: The schoolz scraper machine has not reported in 15 minutes
annotations.description: It never auto-stops, so silence means it is down. Scans fall back to the shared droplet, which is why this is a ticket and not a page.

rules.title: schoolz: an uptime probe is not reporting

annotations.summary: Fewer than two uptime checks are reporting
annotations.description: schoolz-site-unreachable can only fire for a check that reports. A check that was deleted, disabled or renamed leaves that half of the site unwatched, silently.

rules.title: schoolz: a visitor's auth check never resolved

annotations.summary: {{ $values.B.Value }} visitor(s) hit the auth timeout fallback in 30 minutes
annotations.description: AuthContext gave up waiting and showed Reload. This is the failure that left signed-in mobile visitors stuck on 'Loading...' - see the onAuthStateChange comment in frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx. It should be zero.

rules.title: schoolz: Alexa skill Lambda is erroring

annotations.summary: The Alexa skill failed {{ $values.B.Value }} invocations in 30 minutes
annotations.description: Each one is a person hearing 'there was a problem with the requested skill's response'. The Lambda's log group has the traceback.

rules.title: schoolz: a route is returning 5xx

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.http_request_method }} {{ $labels.http_route }} returned {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} server errors in 30 minutes
annotations.description: Names the route behind an availability burn. On its own it is only a pointer - the SLO alert decides whether it matters.

rules.title: schoolz: a route's p95 is above 2.5s

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.http_route }} p95 is {{ printf "%.1f" $values.B.Value }}s
annotations.description: Names the route behind a latency burn. Only routes with more than 20 requests in the window count, so one cold start can't trip it.

model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="schoolz", service_name="schoolz-api", http_request_method="GET", http_route!~"/prerender|/chat.*|/admin.*|/scraper.*|/scheduled-jobs.*|/health"}[30m]))) and on (http_route) sum by (http_route) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="schoolz", service_name="schoolz-api", http_request_method="GET", http_route!~"/prerender|/chat.*|/admin.*|/scraper.*|/scheduled-jobs.*|/health"}[30m])) > 20

rules.title: schoolz: scraper failing more than 30% of page loads

annotations.summary: {{ humanizePercentage $values.B.Value }} of scraper page loads are failing
annotations.description: Either the scraper machine is unhealthy or many school sites are unreachable. Callers retry and fall back to the droplet, so the scans SLO says whether this hurt.

rules.title: schoolz: a scan kind mostly finds nothing

annotations.summary: {{ humanizePercentage $values.B.Value }} of {{ $labels.job_kind }} runs ended in a warning over 24h
annotations.description: Fetched fine, found nothing. For a kind that normally finds something, a site redesign looks exactly like this.

model.expr: sum by (job_kind) (increase(schoolz_job_runs_total{service_namespace="schoolz", status="warning"}[24h])) / sum by (job_kind) (increase(schoolz_job_runs_total{service_namespace="schoolz", status!="skipped"}[24h]) > 5)

rules.title: schoolz: parse issues spiking

annotations.summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} {{ $labels.code }} parse issues from {{ $labels.job_kind }} in 6h
annotations.description: Scans are succeeding but dropping content. This is the failure mode that doesn't turn anything red - coverage degrades quietly.

rules.title: schoolz: scans are queueing

annotations.summary: Scans wait {{ humanizeDuration $values.B.Value }} at p95 for a concurrency slot
annotations.description: Too many jobs landing in the same minute, or one long job holding a slot.

rules.title: schoolz: LLM token use well above normal

annotations.summary: {{ humanize $values.B.Value }} LLM tokens in 24h
annotations.description: A normal day is well under half of this. A loop re-extracting the same content, or a translation backfill, looks like this.

rules.title: schoolz: auth check p95 above 5s

annotations.summary: The client-side auth check takes {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }}ms at p95
annotations.description: Short of the outright stall schoolz-auth-stalled catches, but the same failure degrading: every API call waits behind the Supabase auth lock.

model.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {app_name="schoolz-faro"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="auth_ready" | unwrap value_ms [30m])

rules.title: schoolz: new user registered

annotations.summary: A new account was just created
annotations.description: Local register or a first Supabase sign-in. The `user_created` log line has the source.

rules.title: schoolz: Alexa skill Lambda throttled

annotations.summary: The Alexa skill Lambda was throttled {{ $values.B.Value }} times in 30 minutes
annotations.description: The account's concurrency limit was hit. Expected never at this traffic.

rules.title: schoolz: a scan has failed twice in a row

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.job }} failed twice in a row ({{ $labels.error_code }})
annotations.description: One failure is usually a flaky site; two in a row is real. The Runs tab in /admin has the stage and traceback for this job.

model.rawSql:
SELECT j.kind, j.name AS job, COALESCE(j.last_error_code, 'unknown') AS error_code, 1 AS value
FROM scheduled_jobs j
WHERE j.enabled AND (
  SELECT count(*) FROM (
    SELECT r.status FROM job_runs r
    WHERE r.job_id = j.id AND r.status NOT IN ('skipped', 'running')
    ORDER BY r.started_at DESC LIMIT 2
  ) last2 WHERE last2.status = 'error'
) = 2

rules.title: schoolz: newsletters not scanned in 8 days

annotations.summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} newsletter(s) have missed a weekly scan
annotations.description: The Scans dashboard lists which. An expired per-issue URL does not show up here - it scans fine and finds nothing (smore_no_blocks).

model.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM smore_newsletters
WHERE last_scanned_at IS NULL OR last_scanned_at < now() - interval '8 days'

rules.title: schoolz: flyer images waiting on vision extraction

annotations.summary: {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }} image block(s) have been pending for a day
annotations.description: A failed vision extract stays pending and retries on the next scan; a day of it means the image itself can't be read.

model.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM smore_blocks WHERE pending_vision_extraction
